newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec sets C$350 million bond due October, 2007.
newsitem.headline: Quebec sets C$350 million bond due October, 2007.

text.p: The province of Quebec on Thursday issued a 6.5 percent C$350 million bond due October 1, 2007 in financial markets, lead manager Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion Inc said.
The bond was set at C$98.38 with a yield of 6.715 percent for a spread of 41 basis points over the Government of Canada 7.25 percent bond due June 1, 2007.
Payment and delivery of the bond will take place on February 25, 1997 and the first long coupon will be paid on October 1, 1997.
Members of the syndicate underwriting the bond include Levesque, RBC Dominion Securities Inc, ScotiaMcLeod Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, Merrill Lynch Canada Inc and Nesbitt Burns Inc.
